User review actual 6/mockup 8. Add a thin per-unit mass strip aligned with the recall axis/detail viewport. Draw exactly supplied UnitAnchor.mass and externalMass on declared fixed 0–1 scales. These quantities are not complements; other source mass can remain. A zero-mass fill remains zero with a visible origin marker. Missing anchor mass for untimed/unanchored rows is explicit unavailable, never zero. Do not label this calibrated confidence. Acceptance: real full NN03 zero-fill plus synthetic high external/flat posterior/coarse/untimed witnesses; values read back equal producer marks; moving viewport or selecting a row never rescales masses. Keep all counts including 35 external-dominant and 0 unanchored; headline 44 zero-mass fills with moved108/173 in the full arm.

Reuse the existing Voyage document/compiler/lowering/view; no new frontend or view-side scientific inference. Preserve semantic identities, supplied values, origin shapes, external-dominant hollows, group-level support and existing inspector exact text. Do not add native media boundaries or evidence links without checked producer capabilities. Record exact revision/artifact tuple and run affected Scala gates plus real-browser and synthetic failure witnesses. Existing frozen Sherlock artifacts are regression inputs, not scientific validation. Rollback: disable the new display/control and retain the existing checked Voyage route; never rewrite original artifacts. An actual Intaglio deficiency belongs in ~/code/scala/intaglio with its own Mote ticket and producer-consumer witness. No renderer defect is established by this ticket.
set.title: [Voyage] Show per-unit drawn-anchor and external mass on fixed scales
